description: Search what this node's deskVerify keeps; a read, nothing is written. over "tests": the latest state of each test (its newest row), answering {suite, title, outcome, commit, at, failure} per item, filtered by suite (file name), test (words graded against the test's key and its failure text; a test they do not touch is left out), outcome (red or green), commit (a hash prefix), item (the tests of that item's listed suites), since (an ISO time; rows at or after it) and current ("yes": only tests reported in their suite's latest run, what stands now). Since goal/G27.14 a test's key is its place, its sub-heading and its number under it, the same red or green. over "runs": each check it made, answering {kind, id, state, commit, queued, started, ended, outcome, line}, filtered by item, kind (item, red, goal, full), commit and since (queued at or after it). Every key but over is optional; a filter that does not belong to over is ignored. Answers {items: [{key, label: the row as json}], more, total}, newest first, bucket-bounded: more true means the answer is partial, so narrow the filters; total is how many matched in all.
